name: nhs-app
author: Nik Colley
//: Terminal commands for the scripts below:
npm test              - run all tests headless (no browser window), except the login test
npm run test:head     - run all tests with the browser visible
npm run test:ui       - open Playwright's interactive UI to pick and step through tests
npm run test:api      - run only the API tests (no browser needed)
npm run test:a11y     - run only the accessibility tests (WCAG 2.2 AA scans, keyboard and structure checks)
npm run test:login    - log in to NHS login with the details in .env (copy .env.example to .env first)
npm run codegen       - record a new test against https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-app/
Add Playwright options after --, e.g. npm run test:head -- --project=chromium
